description_en: Intelligently erases unwanted elements from e-commerce images, automatically identifying and removing text, specific names, transparent text blocks, and image blemishes, with support for specifying objects to erase as needed for efficient and precise batch processing that simplifies image editing workflows. (Synchronous)
description_zh: 图像智能消除产品专为电商图片定制，自动识别并消除电商图片中的文字、特定名称、透明字块和牛皮癣，可按需指定消除图片内对象，实现大批量图片的高效、精确处理，简化图片编辑工作。（同步）
name: ImageRemove

parameters.description_en: The URL of the image to process. This parameter is mutually exclusive with ImageBase64. You must specify one of them.
parameters.help_en: The URL of the image to process. This parameter is mutually exclusive with ImageBase64. You must specify one of them
parameters.name: image_url

parameters.description_en:
The elements to remove from the image subject area. Valid values:
- 1: transparent text block
- 2: specific name
- 3: text
- 4: image blemish

You can specify multiple values.
parameters.description_zh: 去除图片主体上的元素（1=透明字块；2=特定名称；3=文字；4=牛皮癣），可多选

parameters.description_en:
The elements to remove from the non-subject area of the image. Valid values:
